# Challenge 5: bypass the native checker

Make `nativeCheckSecret` accept **anything**. The native C code must never
see the input.

**Hints**:

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

A native Java method is still a Java method.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

`implementation` replacement short-circuits the native side completely.
</details>

[Breaking the native check](../android_journey/breaking_the_native_check.qmd)
shows the native address path. This challenge is the Java short-circuit
instead.
